All runtime commands assume a **frappe-bench** with frappe, erpnext (and payments) installed, run from the bench root.

## Install / setup

- Add the app: `bench get-app <repo-url-or-path>`.
- Install it on a site: `bench --site <site> install-app healthcare`.
- Install dev requirements: `bench setup requirements --dev`.
- Build desk assets: `bench build --app healthcare`.
- Run migrations and patches: `bench --site <site> migrate`.

## Tests

- `bench --site test_site run-parallel-tests --app healthcare` is what CI runs.
- To run a single doctype's tests: `bench --site <site> run-tests --app healthcare --doctype "Patient Appointment"`.

## Lint / format (from the app dir)

- `pip install pre-commit && pre-commit install && npm install`
- `pre-commit run --all-files` runs trailing-whitespace, yaml/json/toml/ast checks, debug-statements, prettier, eslint, pip-audit, `ruff --fix`, `ruff-format`, and detect-secrets.
- Semgrep:
  - `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/frappe/semgrep-rules.git .frappe-semgrep-rules`
  - `semgrep ci --config ./.frappe-semgrep-rules/rules --config r/python.lang.correctness`

## Patient Portal

- Run `yarn install` at the root. The `postinstall` hook installs `patient_portal`.
- `yarn build` at the root runs `cd patient_portal && yarn build`, which is `vite build --base=/assets/healthcare/patient_portal/`.
- `cd patient_portal && yarn dev` starts the Vite dev server, proxying to Frappe.

## Translations

- `.github/helper/update_pot_file.sh` regenerates `healthcare/locale/main.pot`. It runs weekly in CI.
